reference.title: Haystack Tags Import File format
reference.shortdesc: The Tags Import File is a JSON file used to add, modify, or remove tag and relation definitions in the Haystack tag dictionary. You can generate a template JSON import file using the Make Import Files action on the Haystack tag dictionary. Edit the generated JSON file as needed, then configure the dictionary to load it during an Import Dictionary action.

section.title: About the JSON structure
section.p: Version : A required string indicating the version of the import file."version": "3.0.2 MyCompany.1" ``
Definition: An array of tag and relation definition objects. Each object represents a single tag or relation to add, modify, or remove.

section.title: Tag definition objects
section.p:
Each tag definition entry contains the following fields:
name
The tag name:
If the name already exists, the definition is overwritten.
kind
Defines the tag kind (for example, "Marker", "Bool", "Number", "Str", "URI", "Ref", "Date").
"Ref" kinds define relations rather than tags.
"Remove"
smartType (optional)
Defines the smart tag or smart relation type in module:typeName format. Defaults:
No impliedTagRules → SimpleTagInfo
With impliedTagRules → SmartTagInfo
kind = "Ref" with no smartType → R
impliedTagRules (optional)
An array defining TagRule conditions for smart tags. Multiple entries are treated as logical AND.
Ignored for kind = "Ref".
validityRules (optional)Rules determining when a tag or relation is considered valid in UI selection tools. Used to generate TagInfo or RelationInfo entries.
hasTags (optional)Array of tag names. Specifies an OR‑combined BooleanFilter condition for smart tag implication.
isType (optional)
Defines an IsTypeCondition in "module:typeName" format.
hasAncestor (optional)
Defines a HasAncestorCondition. Multiple tags produce an OR condition
filter (optional)A full NEQL predicate specifying a Boolean filter. All tag names must be fully qualified with namespaces.
units (optional)
A long‑name unit string from the UnitsDatabase. Added as a defaultFacet on the TagInfo entry.

section.title: About relations (ref kind)
section.p: To define or modify a relation, set "kind": "Ref".
